T: On the run. Still need dinner.
D: Harry, Ron and Hermione leave Hogwarts behind to hunt down Voldemort's Horcruxes.
P: Serve the snacks when the guests arrive for Bill and Fleur's wedding at the Burrow.
S: Blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, plus gruyere choux puffs
Smoked salmon on blinis with crème fraîche and dill, and little gougères of gruyère choux, laid out on silver trays for the guests.
the late-night café where the Death Eaters find them

Thick white bread toasted in butter around leg ham, melted vintage cheddar and a scrape of hot English mustard, cut into triangles. Butter the outsides of 8 slices thick white bread. Spread the insides of 4 slices with English mustard, then layer with 200g leg ham and 200g grated vintage cheddar and close with the other slices, butter side out. Cook in a frying pan over medium-low heat for 3 to 4 minutes a side, pressing down with a spatula, until deep golden and the cheese runs. Cut into triangles and serve with a pickle on the side.
Mayo and lemon crab on toasted sourdough fingers
Crab meat folded through mayo, lemon and chives, piled onto toasted sourdough with a pinch of paprika.
M: Frozen pond foil baked trout with potatoes
Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil

Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil over the coals until flaky, with buttery parsley potatoes. Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil. Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and parsley.
Godric's Hollow beef and red wine pie
Christmas Eve in snowy Godric's Hollow

Beef chuck and onion simmered 3 hours in stock and red wine, spooned into a dish under puff pastry and baked at 200C for 25 minutes. Toss 1kg diced beef chuck in 2 tbsp seasoned plain flour and brown in batches. Soften 2 onions and 2 carrots in the pot, add 250ml red wine and bubble 2 minutes. Add 500ml beef stock, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 2 bay leaves, cover and simmer 2.5 to 3 hours until tender. Cool a little, spoon into a pie dish and cover with 1 sheet puff pastry. Brush with egg and bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with buttered greens.
W: Butter sponge layers with lemon zest, filled with lemon curd

Lemon sponge baked in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes, filled with lemon curd and whipped cream, dusted with icing sugar and topped with white flowers. Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of a lemon, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, dust with icing sugar and top with white flowers.
K: Milk whisked with dark chocolate and cinnamon until frothy
Dark chocolate melted into hot milk with a pinch of cinnamon, whisked and poured into tin mugs.

veg.n: Foil baked stuffed eggplant with potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Stuff and wrap the eggplants up to 1 day ahead and keep them in the fridge; cook the eggplants and boil the potatoes on the night

steps.text: Cut a deep slit along each eggplant and stuff with lemon slices, dill, the butter for the eggplant and crumbled fetta, then season with salt and pepper.
Wrap in foil brushed with the olive oil.
Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 35 minutes until soft.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Toss the potatoes in the butter for the potatoes and the parsley.
Serve the eggplant in its foil.
Beat the butter and sugar until pale, add the eggs one at a time with the lemon zest, then fold in the flour.

Cool completely.
Whip the cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Chop the chocolate and mix it with the cinnamon up to 1 week ahead in a jar; heat the milk and whisk on the night

steps.text: Heat the milk until steaming.
Whisk in the chocolate and cinnamon until smooth and frothy.
Pour into mugs.

s.note: Blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill, plus gruyere choux puffs
s.how: Top 16 blinis with crème fraîche, smoked salmon and dill. For gougeres, boil 125ml water with 50g butter, beat in 75g flour, then 2 eggs and 75g grated gruyere. Pipe small balls and bake at 200C for 20 minutes. Arrange both on silver trays.

s.note: Mayo and lemon crab on toasted sourdough fingers
s.how: Fold 250g crab meat through 3 tbsp mayonnaise with lemon zest, a squeeze of juice and snipped chives. Toast slices of sourdough and cut into fingers. Pile the crab on top and finish with a pinch of smoked paprika. Serve by the sea if you can.

m.note: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil
m.how: Stuff 4 cleaned trout with lemon slices, dill and butter, season and wrap in oiled foil. Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C for 18 minutes. Serve with 800g boiled potatoes tossed in butter and parsley.

w.note: Butter sponge layers with lemon zest, filled with lemon curd
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and the zest of a lemon, then fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Fill with lemon curd and whipped cream, dust with icing sugar and top with white flowers.

d.note: Milk whisked with dark chocolate and cinnamon until frothy
d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth and frothy. Pour into tin mugs and wrap your hands around it while the wind shakes the tent outside.
